description: The first step to clear the profile of the authenticated user. The user's password is verified and, if the user has two factor authentication enabled, a 401 error that includes a twoFaToken is returned. The token is then used to submit a ClearProfileWithTwoFactorAuthToken. If the user does not have two factor authentication enabled a 401 error with the TWO_FA_ENABLED_REQUIRED code is returned and the profile cannot be cleared.

password.description: The current password of the authenticated user.
